author: The Current
description:
Ed Jurdi and Gordy Quist from The Band of Heathens on being an independent band
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Austin, Texas, act The Band of Heathens have been together for 20 years, and they have never been on a record label. The Current's Bill DeVille points out that many reviews of The Band of Heathens use "fiercely independent" to describe the band. "It's very accurate," band co-founders Ed Jurdi and Gordy Quist respond in unison. Hear more about what they have to say about what it means to them to be an independent band.
